expected_behavior: The checker only reads: it never edits, renames or moves a file, and it opens no network connection.
It checks the whole tree as it stands, not only the files in the diff.
scaffold.mjs prints a proposed arch.json and writes it only when no declaration exists, or when --force is passed.
Every violation is reported as file:line with a rule name, and the run exits 1 when there is at least one.
Files no declared layer claims, and rules the declaration cannot cover, are listed as unrated instead of passing silently.
Imports are read only from code files and never from comment lines, so a path quoted in documentation or a fixture is not a dependency.
